messages: #p103# says she will make me something even better.

For this last experiment, #p103# promised to make me a mysterious scroll. For that, she needs #b1 #t4010107##k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b10 vials of #t2012002##k. Maybe I should ask the fairies in #m10002000# for the #t4010107#...

I got the materials #p103# needed and the scroll for gloves was made without a hitch. Sweet! #p103# expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting. Maybe next time I return I'll be able to buy something from her that's not sold in stores...
name: Jane's Final Challenge
